title: Joint
description: A kinematic joint connecting two bones in the rig hierarchy. Degrees of freedom + ROM limits are used by engine/rig.py to clamp forward-kinematics so posed configurations stay within human anatomical bounds, including combined/rotational end-of-range poses.

coordinate_system_standard.description: e.g. 'ISB Wu et al. 2005 shoulder JCS'; 'none - custom' if no ISB standard exists

center_definition.description: how the joint center / rotation axis is anatomically defined

axis_name.description: e.g. flexion-extension, abduction-adduction, internal-external rotation, pronation-supination, radial-ulnar deviation

coupled_motion_notes.description: documented non-independence between axes, e.g. scapulohumeral rhythm, tibial screw-home mechanism
